subject: english
question:
Select the most appropriate option that can substitute the underlined segment in the given sentence.

Natwar was a fraudster who always tried to __fooling__ others.
solution:
The correct answer is "**deceive**."

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Let us understand the meaning of the underlined and the marked word:
 
 
• "**To fool**" means to trick someone or make someone appear stupid in some way.(मूर्ख बनाना)

 
 
• Example: You made a fool of me in front of everyone!
 
 
 
• "**Deceive**" means to trick or mislead someone.(धोखा देना)
 
 
• Example: He has deceived us all.
 
• It is the most appropriate option as it conveys the same meaning as "trying to fooling others".
 
 
 
 

Hence, **the correct answer is option 2**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__** 

 
• "**Betraying"** means to reveal secrets or be disloyal.(धोखा)
 
• "**Cheating**" means to act dishonestly in order to gain an advantage.(बेईमानी करना)
 
• "**Revealing**" means to make something known or public.(खुलासा)

3f:Tb50,
The correct answer is "**Assent.**
